description_en: Adds or removes assigned users for a delivery group. Only users added as assigned users can access cloud applications
description_zh: 为交付组添加或移除分配用户。只有添加到分配用户的用户可访问云应用
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center authorize-instance-group --app-instance-group-id aig-9ciijz60n4xsv0000 --product-type CloudApp --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AuthorizeInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en: The delivery group ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428506.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The delivery group set ID. You must specify either AppInstanceGroupSetId or AppInstanceGroupId, but not both
parameters.help_zh: 交付组集合 ID。AppInstanceGroupSetId 与 AppInstanceGroupId 必须且只能指定一个
parameters.name: app_instance_group_set_id

parameters.help_en: The list of usernames to add to the delivery group authorization. You can specify 1 to 100 usernames
parameters.help_zh: 要添加交付组授权的用户名列表。可设置1\~100个
parameters.name: authorize_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of usernames to remove from the delivery group authorization. You can specify 1 to 100 usernames
parameters.help_zh: 要移除交付组授权的用户名列表。可设置1\~100个
parameters.name: un_authorize_user_ids

parameters.help_en:
The persistent session ID.

Metric description
This parameter is required when the authorization mode of the delivery group is Session. You can call the ListPersistentAppInstances operation to obtain a valid ID.
This parameter is required when ProductType is set to WuyingServer. You can call the ListPersistentAppInstances operation to obtain a valid ID
parameters.help_zh:
持久会话ID。

参数说明
当 交付组的授权模式为Session 时本参数为必填，可通过 ListPersistentAppInstances 获取有效 ID。
当 ProductType 为 WuyingServer 时本参数为必填，可通过 ListPersistentAppInstances 获取有效 ID
parameters.name: app_instance_persistent_id

parameters.help_en:
The user avatar ID.

This parameter is not available for public use
parameters.help_zh:
用户分身ID。

此参数不开放使用
parameters.name: avatar_id

parameters.help_en: The list of authorized user group IDs to grant authorization
parameters.name: authorize_user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of authorized user group IDs to revoke authorization
parameters.name: un_authorize_user_group_ids
